description: Estimate what a United Airlines ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

card.description: Paying with a United card. none = No; CM = Cardmember (+3 per $1); EX = Explorer (+6 per $1); QU = Quest (+7 per $1); CL = Club (+8 per $1); GW = Gateway (+5 per $1); DB = Gateway Debit (+4 per $1). Cardmember is a United card that you are not paying with.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of United Airlines's own: aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare type. ST = Standard (Economy and above); BE = Basic Economy.

flights.description: Flights on this ticket. Each flight (segment) earns 1 PQF. Basic Economy earns none.

price.description: Ticket price (fare plus carrier-imposed charges, without government taxes) in US dollars. Shown on your receipt as the fare plus carrier-imposed charges. Required unless creditTo is given.

status.description: Your MileagePlus status. none = General (No status); PS = Silver; PG = Gold; PP = Platinum; 1K = 1K.

name: calculate_united_miles
title: United MileagePlus Calculator
